prompt:
Create a NEW illustration in EXACTLY the visual style of the reference images.
STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground, muted blue fill accents, soft dark ink line.

Layout: a THREE-PANEL horizontal strip. Three panels of equal size in one horizontal row, separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. A title bar sits in the cream margin above the panels; one short caption sits in the cream gutter under each panel; a footer bar sits in the cream margin below the panels. Text sits only in the cream margins, never over the artwork.

The same two people appear in all three panels and must be recognizably the same people in each panel: (1) THE DREAM ENGINEER, a woman in her forties with short grey-streaked black hair, wearing a rust-colored cardigan over a plain cream shirt; (2) THE DREAMER, a man in his late twenties with short curly dark hair, wearing a deep-olive sweater. EXACTLY ONE of each person per panel, never duplicated. ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

IMPORTANT: when the two people are talking to each other, there is NO laptop between them and NO device in their hands. The conversation is purely human. The machinery works in the BACKGROUND, at a distance.

BEAT ONE (left panel): two friends fully present with each other over coffee at a small garden table. The dreamer hands the dream engineer a small hand-drawn sketch page showing a simple drawing of a little house under a sun; apart from that drawing the page is BLANK with no readable words. She receives it warmly, leaning in, listening. NO laptop anywhere in this panel. Warm hillside garden behind them.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): the consequence. The two friends walk together in the foreground along a garden path at dusk, still deep in conversation, the sketch in her hand, neither of them looking back. BEHIND them, at a distance, through the open window of a small studio, a LARGE glowing translucent amber laptop sits open on a desk facing the window, clearly readable: inside its bright screen a small rounded commander figure in a gold military cap directs several tiny rounded helper agents actively building the sketched house, and warm amber light spills from the window into the evening. The laptop is the clear light source of the panel and the scene inside its screen is legible. The people pay it no attention; it simply cooks in the background.

BEAT THREE (right panel): morning. The dream engineer ARRIVES carrying the finished little wooden house model in both hands, solid and real, the same house that was sketched in beat one, and presents it to the astonished dreamer at his doorstep. Tucked under her arm is a much LARGER rolled blank page, offered for the next, bigger dream. The page is completely BLANK. NO laptop in this panel.

Physical relationships: the sketch page in beat one is the same page she carries in beat two; the house being assembled inside the distant laptop screen in beat two is the same house design she delivers in beat three; the laptop appears ONLY in beat two, far in the background, small, inside the studio window.

Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in this placement, and no other text anywhere:
Title bar above the panels, in caps: "THE APPLIED AI DREAM ENGINEER"
Caption under the left panel, in caps: "PROMPT ME, NOT THE AI"
Caption under the middle panel, in caps: "THE AGENTS BUILD IT"
Caption under the right panel, in caps: "NOW DREAM BIGGER"
Footer bar below the panels, in caps: "EXECUTION STOPS BEING THE LIMIT. IMAGINATION BECOMES IT."

no comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults
